text.en: This Order shall be cited as the Water Supply Act (Amendment) Order, 2014. of section 2 of Chapter 121.

Section 2 of the Water Supply Act, in this Order referred to as the principal amended, in the definition of "Water Authority", by deleting "Director" from the first line and by substituting "Director General" therefor.

Section 3 of the principal Act is amended in subsection ( 1) - (a} by deleting "His Highness" from the first line and by substituting "His the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan" therefor;

(b) by inserting the following new subsection _immediately after ( 1) - "(1A) Subject to subsection ( 1), His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council may designate the activities that may be carried on in a catchment area.".
Section 7 of the principal Act is amended by inserting "Darussalam" after "Brunei" in the ~econd line.
Section 9 of the principal Act is amended by deleting the semicolon from the seventh line and by substituting a colon therefor.
Section 11 of the principal Act is amended by inserting "Darussalam" immediately after "Brunei" in the third line.
Section 12 of the principal Act is repealed and the following new section substituted therefor - "What is domestic supply.
Section 13 of the principal Act is amended, in paragraph (e}, by deleting the and by substituting a comma therefor.
Section 16 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "Director" from the first line and by substituting "Director General" therefor.
Section 23 of the principal Act is amended by inserting "an authorised" immediately before "meter" in the second line.

Section 24 of the principal Act is amended - (a} in paragraph (d}, by deleting "or" from the last line; (b} in paragraph (e}, by deleting the full stop and by substituting "; or" (c} by adding the following new paragraph"(f} if the premises or any part thereof were erected in contravention of any written law.".
A supply of water for domestic purposes shall not include a supply of to any premises any part of which is used for the purpose of any trade, manufacture or business.".

Section 26 of the principal Act is amended - {a) in paragraph If), by deleting the semicolon and by substituting a comma {b) by deleting "of $1,000 and in the case of a second and subsequent conviction, to a fine of $3,000 and imprisonment for 6 months" from the last 3 and by substituting "not exceeding $20,000 and, in the case of a second or conviction, to a fine not exceeding $50,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years or both" therefor.
Section 27 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "of $500" from the last line and by substituting "not exceeding $10,000" therefor. Amendment of section 28.
Section 28 of the principal Act is amended by deleting "of $50" from the line and by substituting "not exceeding $10,000 and to a further fine not exceeding $250" therefor.
Section 29 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "of $50" from the third line and by substituting "not exceeding $5,000" therefor. Amendment of section 30.

Section 30 of the principal Act is amended - {a) in subsection (1), by deleting "of $1,500" from the last line and by "not exceeding $50,000" therefor; {b) in subsection (3), by deleting "of $1,500" from the last line and by "not exceeding $50,000" therefor.

Section 31 of the principal Act is amended by deleting "of $1,000, and in the or subsequent conviction, to a fine of $3,000" from the last 2 and by substituting "not exceeding $20,000 and, in the case of a second or conviction, to a fine not exceeding $50,000, imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 years or both" therefor.
Section 32 of the principal Act is amended by deleting "of $1,000" from the and by substituting "not exceeding $20,000" therefor.
Section 33 of the principal Act is amended by deleting "of $3,000 or to for 6 months" from the last 2 lines and by substituting "not imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year or both"
Section 34 of the principal Act is amended by deleting "of $1,500" from the fifth line and by substituting "not exceeding $20,000" therefor.
Section 37 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (1], by deleting "of the last line and by substituting "not exceeding $10,000 or for a term not exceeding one year" therefor.
Section 38 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (3J, by deleting "of $300" from the last line and by substituting "not exceeding $10,000" therefor. of new section 38A.

The principal Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 38 - "Entry into waterworks without consent etc. 38A. Notwithstanding any written law, any person who enters or uses any premises belonging to the Authority, any part of any waterworks, or any reserved by the Authority without the prior consent in writing of the Authority, is guilty of an offence and liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $1,500 .".

Section 39 of the principal Act is amended - {a) in subsection (1), by deleting "Municipal Board" from the last line and by substituting "Authority" therefor; {b) in subsection (2). by deleting "or the Municipal Board" from the second and third lines. of new section 40A.

The principal Act is amended by inserting the following new section after section 4-0 "Compounding of offences. 40A. (1) The Authority may compound any offence under this Act which is as a compoundable offence by collecting from a person suspected of having committed that offence a sum not exceeding $500.

(2) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, make regulations to prescribe the offences which may be compounded.".
Section 42 of the principal Act is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "appropriate Authority fund" from the last line and by substituting "Consolidated Fund" therefor. of Act.

The Act is amended by deleting "Water Authority" wherever it appears, the definition of "Authority" in section 2, and by substituting "Authority" 1st day of Zulkaedah, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 27th. day of August, 2014 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
